Authors: Saxena, A., Goebel, K., Simon, D., & Eklund, N.
Title: Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation
Venue: Proc. IEEE Conf. on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Introduced NASA C-MAPSS dataset (FD001-FD004) simulating turbofan run-to-failure trajectories under exponential wear. Established standard benchmark for ML RUL prediction.
Limitations: Simulation-based without real avionics noise or cyber-tampering ground truth.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Provides foundational benchmark data and physical degradation ground truth.

Title: Performance Benchmarking and Analysis of Prognostic Methods for CMAPSS Datasets
Venue: International Journal of Prognostics and Health Management 5(2)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Surveyed 70+ C-MAPSS papers; established importance of uniform preprocessing, piecewise-linear target clipping (e.g. 125 cycles), and asymmetric NASA scoring.
Limitations: Noted pervasive inconsistent benchmark reporting and evaluation leakage.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Justifies dual evaluation protocol separation (unclipped vs clipped at 125).

Authors: Zheng, S., Ristovski, K., Farahat, A., & Gupta, C.
Title: Long Short-Term Memory Network for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
Venue: Proc. IEEE Conf. on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Demonstrated sequential temporal modeling for C-MAPSS; highlighted value of rolling feature representations for RUL estimation.
Limitations: Computationally heavy deep models; vulnerable to gradient-based sensor attacks.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Informs causal rolling window feature extraction strategy.

Authors: Gu, T., Dolan-Gavitt, B., & Garg, S.
Title: BadNets: Identifying Vulnerabilities in the Machine Learning Model Supply Chain
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Demonstrated that third-party model artifacts can harbor stealthy backdoors and manipulated weights without degrading clean accuracy.
Limitations: Focused on computer vision classifiers rather than regression or joblib serialization.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Establishes requirement for cryptographic integrity and artifact authentication.

Authors: Bernstein, D. J., Duif, N., Lange, T., Schwabe, P., & Yang, B.-Y.
Title: High-speed high-security signatures
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Introduced Ed25519 (Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm over Curve25519) providing collision resistance, small keys (32-byte public, 64-byte signature), and high verification speed.
Limitations: Does not protect data in transit after loading without transport-layer security.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Underpins AeroSentinel asymmetric model manifest authentication.

Authors: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
Title: Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1: Recommendations for Mitigating the Risk of Software Supply Chain Attacks
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Mandates cryptographic verification of software artifacts, provenance tracking, and integrity validation before runtime execution.
Limitations: High-level government guidance without ML-specific serialization controls.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Provides regulatory justification for automated fail-closed artifact verification.

Authors: Fawaz, H. I., Forestier, G., Weber, J., Idoumghar, L., & Muller, P.-A.
Title: Adversarial Attacks on Deep Neural Networks for Time Series Classification
Venue: Proc. IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Demonstrated that minimal, imperceptible perturbations in time-series sequences degrade DNN predictions drastically.
Limitations: Limited to classification tasks; did not evaluate regression or tree ensembles.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Motivates evaluation of synthetic bias and ramp perturbations on time-series RUL.

Authors: Karim, F., Majumdar, S., & Darabi, H.
Title: Adversarial Attacks on Time Series
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Formulated transferability and gradient-based attacks on sequential time-series sensor data.
Limitations: Focuses on white-box gradients against recurrent neural networks.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Informs black-box / sensor manipulation threat model for tree-based models.

Authors: Rabanser, S., Günnemann, S., & Lipton, Z. C.
Title: Failing Loudly: An Empirical Study of Methods for Detecting Dataset Shift
Venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 32)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Demonstrated that standard statistical tests (KS, MMD, Chi-square) fail silently under localized shifts without domain-aligned representations.
Limitations: Evaluated vision and synthetic data; did not evaluate turbofan predictive maintenance.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Underpins our investigation into why univariate drift detectors miss stealthy bias.

Title: Credit Risk Scorecards: Developing and Implementing Intelligent Credit Scoring
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Formulated Population Stability Index (PSI) with standard thresholds: PSI < 0.10 stable, 0.10-0.25 warning, > 0.25 significant shift.
Limitations: Designed for static credit risk; temporal autocorrelation can inflate drift scores.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Provides mathematical foundation for baseline PSI drift detection.

Title: The Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test for Goodness of Fit
Venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association 46(253)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Introduced two-sample KS test measuring maximum empirical CDF divergence.
Limitations: Highly sensitive to sample size (N > 5000); yields false alerts under large benign runs.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Informs interpretation of KS p-values in high-cycle aircraft fleet telemetry.

Authors: Mo, Y., Chabukswar, R., & Sinopoli, B.
Title: Detecting Integrity Attacks on Cyber-Physical Systems
Venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology 22(4)
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Analyzed replay and bias attacks on sensor networks; proved that linear Kalman detectors fail against intelligent replay.
Limitations: Assumes state-space control systems, not data-driven RUL regression pipelines.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Directly motivates AeroSentinel frozen telemetry and replay attack scenarios.

Title: OWASP API Security Top 10 2023
Key_Findings_and_Relevance: Categorizes top API vulnerabilities: broken object-level authorization, unrestricted resource consumption, improper error handling.
Limitations: General web APIs; does not tailor to real-time industrial telemetry ingestion.
Role_in_AeroSentinel: Underpins API hardening and security evaluation of the FastAPI interface.
